title: Survival and transience above the compartment-division threshold
summary: Survival and transience are established throughout the strictly supercritical regime of the noncoagulating compartment model of Anderson, Howells and Rojas La Luz (https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.10223v4, Remark 4.8). Compartments produce molecules at rate b, degrade them at rate d per molecule, exit at rate e, and divide at rate f per molecule, with arbitrary conservative allocation between the daughters.
